query: Who won the 2025 Polish presidential election?
answer: Karol Nawrocki won. He's a conservative historian who ran with the backing of Law and Justice (PiS). In the runoff on 1 June 2025 he got 50.89% of the vote to 49.11% for Warsaw mayor Rafał Trzaskowski, a gap of fewer than 400,000 votes, with turnout at 71.63% [1][2]. Trzaskowski had come first in the first round on 18 May with 31.4% to Nawrocki's 29.5%. He was also ahead in the initial exit poll on runoff night, so Nawrocki's win was an upset [2][3]. Trzaskowski conceded on 2 June [4]. Nawrocki took over from Andrzej Duda when Duda's final term ended on 6 August 2025 [2].
